subject: Does rhdfs Have to be Installed on Each Node on Cluster

messages.author: dd68a26ecdacedb8
messages.subject: Does rhdfs Have to be Installed on Each Node on Cluster
parts:
Do R and the RHadoop components (rhdfs in this question) have to be installed on each server on the cluster? Or, can rhdfs be installed on a shared Linux server that is not part of the cluster and the package used from the shared server to execute hdfs commands?

For reference, the attached PDF shows a sample architecture. Where does rhdfs have to be installed?

messages.subject: Re: Does rhdfs Have to be Installed on Each Node on Cluster
parts: only rmr2 and deps needs to be installed on every machine. For the record, rhive has nothing to do with this project.
